title: Slack vs Microsoft Teams for Remote Teams 2026
description: Slack vs Microsoft Teams for remote teams compared: messaging quality, video calls, integrations, pricing, and which platform actually improves remote work productivity.

features.name: Free Tier
features.tool1Detail: Slack free limits message history to 90 days
features.tool2Detail: Teams free supports unlimited chat for up to 10 users

features.name: Messaging
features.tool1Detail: Slack has best-in-class threading and channels
features.tool2Detail: Teams messaging is functional but less refined

features.name: Video Calls
features.tool1Detail: Slack Huddles are lightweight and spontaneous
features.tool2Detail: Teams supports larger meetings and webinars

features.name: Integrations
features.tool1Detail: Slack has the largest app ecosystem

features.name: Best For
features.tool1Detail: Slack excels for developer and startup culture
features.tool2Detail: Teams excels for enterprise compliance and Office users

verdict: If your team uses Google Workspace or is tech-focused, choose Slack. If your team uses Microsoft 365, choose Teams. For startups under 20 people, Slack free tier is better. For enterprises over 100 people, Teams pricing and compliance features win. Many companies use both: Slack for daily chat, Teams for formal meetings.

faqs.question: Is Slack or Teams better for remote work?
faqs.answer: Both work well for remote work. Slack has better messaging UX and threading. Teams has better video calls and Office integration. The choice depends on your existing ecosystem. If you use Microsoft 365, Teams is included. If you use Google Workspace, Slack integrates better.

faqs.question: How much does Slack cost for a 20-person team?
faqs.answer: Slack Pro costs 145 dollars/month for 20 users at 7.25 dollars/user/mo. Teams Essentials costs 80 dollars/month for 20 users at 4 dollars/user/mo. Teams saves 780 dollars/year for a 20-person team.

faqs.question: Can I use Slack and Teams together?
faqs.answer: Yes, many companies use both. Slack for daily team chat and quick questions. Teams for formal video meetings and Office document collaboration. This works well when teams have different preferences.

faqs.question: Which has better integrations?
faqs.answer: Slack has 2600+ app integrations including GitHub, Jira, Figma, and Notion. Teams has 700+ integrations but excels with Office 365, SharePoint, and OneDrive. Slack wins for breadth, Teams wins for Microsoft depth.

faqs.question: Is Slack free tier enough for small teams?
faqs.answer: Slack free tier is enough for teams under 10 who don't need message history older than 90 days. For growing teams, Slack Pro at 7.25 dollars/user/mo unlocks unlimited history, group video calls, and screen sharing.
